title: formula: the Studio draft check and validate_expression do not refuse == / != on a list-valued field reached through a lookup hop, which lint refuses after #36673
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH

## Finding

PR #36673 (#36237) makes lint and the save path refuse `==` / `!=` between a list-valued field reached through a lookup hop and a scalar. Two doors do not see the hop read yet: the Studio draft check, and the shared-validator half of the `validate_expression` tool. The published ADR-0087 semantic entry `cel-list-equality-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.cel-list-equality-refused.ts`) now names this as a stated limit.

Source: contract review 7122973429 on PR #36673, N1 ("door parity ... has no carrier card; a follow-up card (a hint member for hop targets' list-valued fields) is the place for it").

## Done when

- The Studio draft check and `validate_expression` refuse the same hop-read comparison the lint refuses, with the same `has()`-guarded `in` rewrite, likely through a hint member carrying hop targets' list-valued fields.
- The stated limit in the semantic entry and its changeset sentence is removed in the same PR.
- Pins on each door for a hop to a list-valued field, plus a scalar control.

Blocked-by: #36673
